title: Third Party Transfer Limit - Acknowledgment of Own Risk
text: I hereby acknowledge that I am setting and utilizing the Third Party Transfer (TPT) Limit at my own risk.

title: Third Party Transfer Limit - Applicability to All Accounts
text: I am also aware that the limit would be applicable to all accounts under my Customer ID.

title: Third Party Transfer Limit - Daily Limit Application
text: I understand and agree that the TPT limit is a daily limit and will be applicable to all Third Party transactions.

title: Internet Fraud and Security Disclaimer
text: The internet is susceptible to a large number of frauds and misuse. While the Bank aims at providing utmost security, I shall not hold the Bank responsible for any lapse in the same or compromise at my end.

title: Non-Individuals - Limit Increase as Extension of Financial Rights
text: For Non Individuals, i.e. HUF, Partnerships, Trusts and Companies, increase of limits is merely an extension of the financial rights Limits and existing TPT Limits.

title: Agreement to Additional Terms and Conditions
text: I agree and accept that the above terms and conditions shall be in addition to the Terms and Conditions for the TPT Limit, Third Party Fund Transfer, Account Opening and other various services offered by the Bank.
